records.question: Two brick walls are being built. Each wall has 30 bricks in a single row and there are 50 rows in each wall. How many bricks will be used to make both walls?
records.response:
Each wall has 30 bricks in a single row and there are 50 rows in each wall.
So, each wall will have 30 * 50 = 1500 bricks.
Since there are two walls, a total of 1500 * 2 = 3000 bricks will be used to make both walls.
#### 3000

records.question: There are 24 students in the class. One-third had their school portraits taken before lunch. After lunch, but before gym class, 10 additional students had their portraits taken. After gym class, how many students have not yet had their picture taken?
records.response:
One-third of 24 students is 24/3 = 8 students.
After lunch, 8+10 = 18 students had their portraits taken.
Thus, 24-18 = 6 students have not yet had their picture taken.
#### 6
